data.exact_reserve_text: The result is driven by reserve increases in the closed years, where the 2013 and 2016 years have required reserve strengthening beyond their respective pure year close position. The result for the account has been impacted by the movement in large claim reserves for the 2013 and 2014 years, and late development of certain claims from the 2015 year, as well as an adjustment to reserves on certain more specialised business. data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate held gross claims outstanding at the prior year opening of GBP 145.985m. During the year there was material adverse prioryear development of approximately GBP 84.446m (gross), driven predominantly by movements in large claim reserves and catastrophe-related development on older years (notably 2013, 2014 and 2016) and late development on 2015 claims. The prioryear deterioration was concentrated in casualty-style business (third party liability) with additional movements in property and accident & health.

reserve strengthening beyond their respective pure year close position
movement in large claim reserves for the 2013 and 2014 years, and late development of certain claims from the 2015 year
Unfavourable development for 2016 is particularly disappointing and is driven by catastrophe losses, strengthening of liability reserves and a deterioration in Specialty loss ratios.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet technical provisions (Claims outstanding, 2018 comparative). Prior year development (gross GBP 84.446m) taken from the note headed 'The significant movements in gross claims incurred in respect of claims provisions created at the end of the previous period...' which presents gross movements by statutory class (Fire, Third party liability, Accident & Health). A gross claims development triangle is present and was crosschecked; a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) is disclosed for other years but the PYD value used here is the explicit gross movement note. All monetary figures converted from reported GBP 000s to millions. Some narrative references to reserve movements span multiple pages; exact_reserve_text contains verbatim sentences describing the prior year reserve movement.
